metadata.title: Marvell Is Making a Bigger Bet on India

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Marvell Technology (MRVL, Financials), the semiconductor manufacturer, said it will invest $250 million in India over the next three years to increase its staff and technical activities.The corporation stated it will treble its personnel in the country throughout the term. It will also add a new wing to its Bengaluru office and increase its presence in Hyderabad.Marvell said the investment will contribute in the development of semiconductor products used in artificial intelligence, cloud computing and data centers.This comes after the company marked its 20th anniversary in India. The expansion underscores the country's rising role as a center for semiconductor design, engineering and technological talent.Companies have been looking to diversify their operations across areas and find more engineering capability and so India has become a bigger component of the global semiconductor supply chain.For Marvell, the new investment could enhance its ability to build products for fast-growing infrastructure areas. It can also help the company compete for skilled experts as the demand for semiconductors connected to AI grows.Now investors will want to see how quickly Marvell adds people, builds out its facilities and transforms the investment into product growth.
